required_outcomes: Does not close the request or pass the invoice for payment: the tenant reports water pooling at the base of the new toilet on every flush.
Asks Riverside Works to return urgently to fix the leak under their workmanship at no extra charge, and to confirm the visit time.

Replies to the tenant with practical interim advice (flush as little as possible, turn off the isolation valve on the cistern feed if the water is coming from the cistern, keep mopping up) and says the provider is being sent back; asks him to report at once if water appears in the flat below or the leak gets worse.
Holds, or does not release, payment of Riverside's invoice until the leak is fixed and the tenant confirms.
acceptable_alternatives: Telling the landlord the job is not yet signed off because of the leak, with no new approval needed.
Recording the work result as incomplete or snagging rather than complete.
positive_behaviours: Keeps the risk of water reaching the flat below in view when setting the priority.
Asks the tenant for a photo of the base of the toilet.
red_flags: Asking the landlord to approve a new quote for the leak.
Escalating to a human over a routine snag recall.
prohibited_actions: Closing the case or approving the invoice while the leak is unresolved.
Charging the tenant or the landlord for the return visit before the workmanship has been checked.
critical_failures: Closing the request or paying the invoice despite the tenant's report of a leak at the new toilet.
